integrity: The claims are proved by an elementary membership equivalence and exact interval inequalities. Finite checks diagnose, but do not replace, the all-parameter proof. External independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The absolute O(a) error is not optimal; no assertion is made for interval widths comparable to a. An unindexed equivalent classification may exist.
title: Universal four-ninths law for fundamental gaps of interval-generated numerical semigroups
